value.rationale: The published model identifies the finite-capacity paradox numerically but lacks a quantitative capacity policy cutoff. This class-wide theorem supplies an explicit sharp K_c for every positive PD payoff matrix and cooperator initial value, identifies the unique optimal timing via population size N=K_c, and reveals independence from resource adjustment speed and initial resource level. Its precise critical interior limiting resource is a genuine boundary phenomenon, not a routine restatement of the model or a single arbitrary numeric test.
